notes: ROBOTS.TXT CHECK (Rule 2 pre-flight): live robots.txt is DataDome-blocked like everything else, so verified via Wayback CDX (most recent 200 captures: 2024-09-19 len=2218 and 2025-05-31 len=2013, same content digest). ACCESS: saksfifthavenue.com is protected by DataDome (geo.captcha-delivery.com challenge script served on every path including /robots.txt and /, HTTP 403, identical 782-byte block body). Full Rule 2 sweep exhausted: (1) direct fetch -- 403; (2) curl_cffi impersonation across 20 profiles (chrome99-131, chrome133a, edge99/101, safari15_3/15_5/17_0, firefox133/135, chrome99_android) -- 403 with byte-identical 782-byte DataDome block body on every single profile, i.e. TLS-fingerprint spoofing alone does not clear this WAF (looks like IP-reputation based blocking); (3) r.jina.ai reader proxy -- found to be unreachable/challenged from this worker's own egress on ANY target (verified against https://example.com too, so this is a network-level r.jina.ai outage for this session, not saks-specific); (4) translate.goog proxy -- successfully fetched /robots.txt as plain text (used for the robots check above) but returned Google's own 'Can't translate this page' error (HTTP 400) for every HTML page (/, /c/home, /c/home/home-decor) -- Google's own fetcher appears to be blocked/challenged rendering saks HTML; (5) WebFetch -- 403 Forbidden, no body; (6) api.allorigins.win -- HTTP 520; corsproxy.io -- HTTP 403. No browser automation used (shared-browser-pool prohibition). STRUCTURE-RECOVERY WORKAROUND: Wayback Machine has extensive, frequently-refreshed (through Aug 2026) captures of saks category pages, so the full Home-department category taxonomy was reconstructed from Wayback CDX + fetched archived HTML (product-tile alt-text used to verify each bucket's actual contents against scope, per Rule 0/mixed-roll-up requirement). Per this project's Rule 2, Wayback is STRUCTURE ONLY -- every qty below is null+MANUAL REVIEW even where an archived page happened to show a partial-looking count (e.g. Lighting's archived page showed '38 Items' in one capture, and other categories showed similar strings) because Wayback snapshots are not live, are frequently partial/paginated captures, and cannot be exhaustion-checked. HOME DEPARTMENT TOP-LEVEL NAV (from wb capture of /c/home, 2025-05-17, and site mega-menu): Bath, Bedding, Best Sellers, Dining & Entertaining, Fine Art, Home Decor, Home Storage & Organization, Kitchen, Lighting, Luggage & Travel Gear, Sale, Tech Accessories -- Best Sellers/Sale never extracted per brief. EXCLUSIONS (verified via archived product-tile titles, not just category names): Home Decor > Accent Furniture & Rugs (verified titles are 100% furniture -- tables/chairs/benches/cabinets -- and cowhide/wool area rugs; furniture+textiles both excluded), Books (coffee-table books, not decorative accessories per scope), Candles & Diffusers (home fragrance), Decorative Pillows (textiles), Games & Entertainment (not decor), Plants and Flowers (faux-plant exclusion); Dining & Entertaining > Bar & Wine Accessories (bar tools), Silverware & Flatware (cutlery), Table Linens & Accessories (textiles); Bath > Bath Mats, Towels (textiles); Kitchen (all 6 subcats -- Bakeware, Coffee & Tea, Cookware, Electrics/Kitchen Appliances, Kitchen Tools & Accessories, Knives -- are cookware/appliances/cutlery, wholly excluded); Bedding (textiles, wholly excluded); Home Storage & Organization (verified titles: jewelry/watch boxes, watch winders, zip cases, kitchen canisters, cookie jar -- predominantly functional storage/organization, not in the brief's decorative-accessories list, judged out of scope as a mixed roll-up leaning functional -- dropped per 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad'); Luggage & Travel Gear (luggage, not decor); Tech Accessories/Household Tech (electronics). INCLUDED, verified via archived titles: Home Decor > Bowls, Vases & Trays (vases/trays/bowls/centerpieces -- exact scope match), Home Accents (clocks, sculptures/figurines, trinket trays, decorative boxes -- scope match), Picture Frames, Wall Decor & Mirrors (framed art/prints, mirrors, wall plates, shadow boxes -- scope match, RULE 0 mirrors-are-always-in-scope applied); Lighting -- flat by-type nav (NOT room-organized on this site; CDX crawl history confirms only 4 real type subcategories exist: Chandeliers, Pendant Lights, Table Lamps, Wall Sconces -- no room-based branches were found in any capture, so Rule 0's room-traversal requirement is moot here, there is no room tree); Dining & Entertaining > Dinnerware, Drinkware & Glassware, Serveware (tableware/glassware, filed under Kitchen & Dining per brief instruction; Serveware included as decorative-adjacent serving trays/bowls, distinct from the excluded cutlery/bar-tools buckets); Bath > Bath Accessories (verified titles: marble/crystal trays, soap dishes/dispensers, canisters, tissue box covers, wastebaskets -- genuinely decorative bathroom accessories per brief); Fine Art (childless leaf -- framed prints/engravings/screenprints, verified via titles, wall-art scope match). Company/duplicate determination: Saks Home (saksfifthavenue.com) is a distinct company/domain from any other roster entry in this project to date; not flagged as a duplicate.
